description:
The Hide Vendors module in Odoo allows vendor managers to control which users can view vendor information for products. By enabling or disabling a Boolean option in the user's settings, vendors can be hidden from specific users.

User Access Control
The "Show Vendors" Boolean option in the user's settings allows the manager to control whether a user can see vendor details.
Vendor Visibility in Product View
If the Boolean is checked, users can view vendor information. If unchecked, vendors are hidden from the product view.
User-Specific Vendor Restrictions
Managers can restrict vendor visibility for certain users by unchecking the "Show Vendors" option in the user settings.

Limit Access: Restrict access to vendor details for specific users within the organization.

name: Product Restriction on Customer
description: Product Restriction on Customer helps businesses control which products are available for each customer during quotation and sales order creation. Authorized users can assign a specific list of allowed products directly from the customer profile, and sales users will then see only those products when selecting items on an order for that customer. The module also includes a dedicated Product Restriction access right, ensuring that only permitted users can view and manage customer-specific product assignments. This makes product selection more accurate, prevents users from choosing unauthorized items, and supports businesses that maintain different product catalogs for different customers.
